title: Backend - separate release state inside the existing Foundry RG

runtime.description: Runtime calls and release operations have different identities and owners

steps.detail: The frontend invokes the existing agent. Frontend receives the agent ID explicitly, not as a Backend Terraform output.
Backend grants the returned agent identity model-alias access.
Backend grants that runtime identity access to each supplied tool-server scope.
Backend grants telemetry publishing on the existing Foundry component; it does not provision that component.
